title: Majestic Victory
reviewNotes: Reconstructed complete four-piece board and selected king walk through repeated side checks. Four checked branches include rook underpromotion, actual queen stalemate, and two early drawing king routes. Verified correct mating threats: c8=R threatens Ra8, ...Ra4 blocks the a-file, and Kb3 attacks the rook while threatening Rc1 mate.
transcript: Fools will resign. Wise players will [music] accept a draw, but only a true genius can find the incredible win that white has in this position. But white has an incredible resource in this position. Of course, we start with C7, [music] getting closer to getting a new queen. Now the king is defending C5 and the pawn is defending D8, so there's no way for the [music] rook to prevent the promotion. But the rook can of course give this check to the king. Now if the king tries to attack this rook, the simple rook D1 is going to secure the draw. And actually, if we get a queen, we're going to lose this game. And king B7 is going to blunder another draw after rook D7, pinning the pawn to the king and securing the draw for black. So actually, the first very precise move that white has to find here >> [music] >> is king B5. But now, the situation has changed. >> [music] >> The king can actually go to C2 because the rook is bound to the limits of the chessboard and it cannot create the skewer threat anymore. But do not celebrate too soon [music] because black does have a last mysterious mysterious move with rook D4. So believe it or not, >> [music] >> the only way for white to win this position is to get a rook. Now, of course, the still meeting trap doesn't work anymore. [music] And we are creating a checkmate threat. And some of you might think, "Well, but Pietro, this [music] doesn't make any sense. The rook can just block the checkmate threat. And now this is a draw. We both have one rook left." You would be mistaken because actually, after king B3, we are [music] attacking the rook and creating a new checkmate >> [music] >> that cannot be stopped in any way, which means that black will have to give us the rook >> [music] >> and lose the game like this.
